lines.t: Morning light through the windowpane, soft wind calling out your name
All my worries drift away, in your peace I wanna stay
Birds sing low, the sky turns gold
Every breath feels like I'm home
In the silence I can hear
Yahushua, you are near
No rushing now, I'm slowing down
Your love is all around
Yahushua, you bring me peace
Like the sunrise on the sea
In your love, my heart is free
You are all I need
Yahushua, gentle light
Hold me close in the morning time
Every breath, every beat
You are life in me
Coffee warm, the day begins
Still I feel you come within
No more fear, no more haste
Only grace I wanna taste
Step by step I walk with you
Every sky feels fresh and new In the quiet I belong
You're the rhythm in my song No rushing now, I'm slowing down
Your love is all around
Yahushua, You bring me peace
Like the sunrise on the sea
In your love, my heart is free
You are all I need
Yahushua, gentle light
Hold me close in morning time
I'm every breath, every beat You are life in me
Peace like a river flowing slow Love like I've never known
Joy rising with the day you wash my fears away
Morning fades, but still I know Wherever I may go
Yahushua, stay with me In your love, I'm free
